The '''HyperMatter Engineering Facility''' was a facility in the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]], a [[Hypermatter/Legends|hypermatter]] refinery on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Galactic War]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces freed the facility's captive engineers from the [[Coronas]] gang.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The HyperMatter Engineering Facility is the site of the Republic mission "Forced Labor," which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.1 along with the rest of the Black Hole.<ref name="TOR" />
